company: Sierra Madre Gold and Silver Ltd.

mines.mine_notes: La Guitarra mine complex in the historic Temascaltepec district, Mexico State, includes three producing underground mines: La Guitarra, Coloso and Nazareno. Restarted test mining July 1, 2024; full commercial production from Jan 1, 2025. 159,704 t milled in 2025. Also owns the Tepic silver-gold property (Nayarit). Announced acquisition of the Del Toro silver mine from First Majestic (Dec 2025; expected to close May 2026) with concurrent C$57.5M financing. Two-stage plant expansion: 500 tpd to 750-800 tpd (Phase 1 by end Q2 2026), then 1,200-1,500 tpd by Q3 2027.
mines.processing: Underground mine with flotation/concentrate plant at ~500 tpd
